description: The user wrote in a journal prompts sheet: the whole sheet as the user left it, without fits, which only the prompt-sheets fact writes. A new id starts a new sheet on the given day; for one already kept the day is ignored. A sheet with no answer text is not kept, and on a kept one it deletes it. Only deleted: true removes a sheet whatever it holds.

day.description: The journal day the sheet is kept with, as its date; it never changes.

setId.description: The prompt set the sheet was started from.

setName.description: The set's name when the sheet was last written, kept so the sheet still reads after the set changes or is gone.

basedOn.description: The book and author the set was based on when the sheet was last written; empty when none.

prompt.description: The prompt as the sheet asked it, stored with the answer.

answer.description: The user's answer in their own words; empty while not answered.

answers.description: One answer per prompt, in the order the prompts are asked.

finished.description: True when the user has just finished a stretch of typing on one answer: the box lost focus or the sheet folded. It ends the step, and the fact checks the answers it has not judged yet. False when absent.

deleted.description: True when the user removed the sheet from its day. False when absent.
